answer: To resist sybil attacks, an agent economy can require every new identity to finish a bonded work voyage before it may vote or grade. The newcomer locks a marble of stake, then must earn attestations from many unrelated established agents on successive live tasks. Fake clones fail because that bonded trail cannot be reused, and coordinated sockpuppets bunch together in the same attestation meadow and are slashed as a cluster. Cost rises with each extra identity, so flooding the ledger becomes uneconomic.
